summary: Push Notification Preferences Screen frontend testing completed successfully. All 14 features verified as WORKING. The screen loads correctly at /notifications/preferences route, displays all required sections, toggles, and default values as specified.

cancellations_no_shows_toggle.details: Toggle is ON by default (green) with description 'When appointments are cancelled or patient doesn't show'

daily_schedule_summary_section.details: Section exists with description 'Receive a summary of your appointments each day'

system_notifications_section.details: Section exists with 2 toggles and description 'Important updates and alerts'

critical_updates_toggle.details: Toggle is ON by default with 'Recommended' badge (green) and description 'System alerts, clinic closures, and emergencies'

quiet_hours_section.details: Section exists with enable toggle and description 'Silence non-critical notifications during specific times'

critical_code_review_comments: Clean architecture with abstracted IPushNotificationService interface for future FCM migration
ExpoPushNotificationService implements all required methods including device registration, permission handling, and notification scheduling
usePushNotifications hook properly manages state, preferences storage via AsyncStorage, and notification handlers
NotificationPreferencesScreen uses proper React patterns with controlled components and state management
Default preferences match specification: appointment toggles ON, daily summary OFF, critical updates ON with 'Recommended' badge
Android notification channels properly configured for different priority levels (default, appointments, critical, schedule)
Quiet hours functionality implemented with proper time-based filtering logic

test_credentials.note: Not required for /notifications/preferences route - loads without authentication
